notes: Short communication with original data. H2 isotherms at 77 K (Fig. 7, y-axis 'Volume Adsorbed (cm3 g-1, STP)', x-axis 'Pressure (mmHg)', 0-850) were measured by the authors; wt.-% values at 850 mm Hg are said to be 'calculated' from the measured isotherms, not from theory. The paper does not use the word volumetric; method inferred from the Micromeritics ASAP 2010 sorption analyzer and the STP volume-adsorbed axis. Carbon sorbent: mesoporous carbon (curve c) left after HF removal of silica, TGA weight loss in O2 of 97 % (Fig. 4b); the carbon/silica composite (curve b, 36.5 % carbon) and phenylene/silica hybrid (curve a) are not carbon sorbents but are not needed. Surface areas: carbon 850 m2/g (method not named, N2 sorption at 77 K), composite 860 m2/g, hybrid 680 m2/g. Not retracted (record is_retracted false). No statement that H2 values were published earlier. Supplementary file contains EDS, XRD, TGA and NMR only; no H2 data.
